subproblem.title: Campanato estimate for the slope Df (parent step 5; Simon 5.(11))
subproblem.statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, U, W ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with W open and W ⊆ U, R ∈ IMRep U n, μ := R.measure, M := R.carrier, κ ∈ ℝ, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ ¼|v − w| and f(0) = 0, z ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, a > 0, s₀ > 0, K ∈ ℝ, Φ(v) := z + ιv + ι'f(v), Df := fderiv ℝ f, graph Df(v) := range(ι + ι'∘Df(v)), p_x the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x, and |A|² := Σ_i |Ae_i|² (standard basis). Assume (hP) x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. strongly measurable; (hdens) unitBallVolume n ≤ (e^{κt}/tⁿ)μ(B_t(y)) for y ∈ spt μ, t > 0, B_t(y) ⊆ W; (hnull) Hⁿ((spt μ ∩ W) ∖ M) = 0; (htan) for Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ W)-a.e. x and every v with x = Φ(v), f is differentiable at v and approxTangentPlane n M x = graph Df(v); B_a(z) ⊆ W; spt μ ∩ B_a(z) = Φ(ℝⁿ) ∩ B_a(z); and for every ξ ∈ spt μ ∩ B_a(z) there is an n-dimensional subspace S with ∫_{B_s(ξ)}|p_x − p_S|²dμ ≤ ofReal(Ks^{n+1}) for all s ∈ (0, s₀]. Then there are C ≥ 0 and s₁ > 0 such that for Lⁿ-a.e. v with |v| < a/2, f is differentiable at v and ∫_{B̆ⁿ_s(v)} |Df(w) − Df(v)|² dw ≤ ofReal(Cs^{n+1}) for every s ∈ (0, s₁].
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (κ : ℝ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (a s₀ K : ℝ), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → (∀ y ∈ R.measure.support, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → closedBall y t ⊆ W → unitBallVolume n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * t) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y t)) → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0 → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ W)), ∀ v : Euclid n, x = z + ι v + ι' (f v) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x = LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ f v).toLinearMap)) → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 * ‖v - w‖) → f 0 = 0 → 0 < a → 0 < s₀ → closedBall z a ⊆ W → R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z a = range (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (f v)) ∩ closedBall z a → (∀ ξ ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z a, ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), Module.finrank ℝ S = n ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * s ^ (n + 1))) → ∃ C s₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < s₁ ∧ ∀ᵐ v ∂volume, v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) (a / 2) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₁ → ∫⁻ w in ball v s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin n, ‖(fderiv ℝ f w - fderiv ℝ f v) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * s ^ (n + 1))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof step 5 (Simon (11)) with C := 2^{n+3}·max(K, 0) and s₁ := min(s₀/2, a/8). The parent's use of the area formula with J ≥ 1 is replaced by its inequality direction, graph_pushforward. Siblings used: graph_tangent_ae (Submission.dorag_gc_graph_tangent_ae), graph_pushforward (Submission.dorag_gc_graph_map_volume_le_measure), graph_projection (Submission.dorag_gc_graph_slope_le_projection).
1. (Geometry.) |Φ(v) − Φ(w)|² = |v − w|² + |f(v) − f(w)|² ≤ (17/16)|v − w|²; for |v| < 4a/5, Φ(v) ∈ spt μ ∩ W and Φ(v) ∈ B_a(z) (as in graph_tangent_ae). Since f is ¼-Lipschitz, ‖Df(w)‖ ≤ 1/4 for every w (Df(w) = 0 where f is not differentiable).
2. (Good parameters.) By graph_tangent_ae, good(v) holds for Lⁿ-a.e. v ∈ Ω' := B̆ⁿ_{4a/5}(0): f is differentiable at v, approxTangentPlane n M Φ(v) = graph Df(v), and every S with a decay bound at Φ(v) equals graph Df(v).
3. Fix a good v with |v| < a/2 (so v ∈ Ω') and s ∈ (0, s₁]; then 2s ≤ s₀ and s ≤ a/8. Let ξ := Φ(v) ∈ spt μ ∩ B_a(z) and let S be given by the decay hypothesis at ξ; by good(v) (with s₀, K), S = graph Df(v). Put ω(x) := |p_x − p_S|².
4. (Pointwise.) B := B̆ⁿ_s(v) ⊆ Ω' since |w| < s + a/2 < 4a/5. For a.e. w ∈ B, good(w) holds, so approxTangentPlane n M Φ(w) = graph Df(w). graph_projection with A₁ := Df(w), A₂ := Df(v) (norms ≤ 1/4) gives |Df(w) − Df(v)|² ≤ 4|p_{graph Df(w)} − p_{graph Df(v)}|² = 4|p_{Φ(w)} − p_S|² = 4ω(Φ(w)).
5. (Image.) Φ(B) ⊆ B_{2s}(ξ), since |Φ(w) − Φ(v)|² ≤ (17/16)s² < 4s².
6. (Push-forward.) graph_pushforward with A := B gives Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞B) ≤ μ⌞Φ(B) ≤ μ⌞B_{2s}(ξ). The weight ofReal∘ω is μ-a.e. measurable (continuous in p_x; (hP)), hence a.e. measurable for Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞B) ≤ μ.
7. (Chain.) ∫_B|Df(w) − Df(v)|²dw ≤ 4∫_B ω(Φ(w))dw = 4∫ ω d(Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞B)) ≤ 4∫_{B_{2s}(ξ)} ω dμ ≤ 4·ofReal(K(2s)^{n+1}) ≤ ofReal(2^{n+3}max(K,0)s^{n+1}) = ofReal(Cs^{n+1}), using the decay bound at ξ with radius 2s ≤ s₀ and 4K(2s)^{n+1} = 2^{n+3}Ks^{n+1}. This holds for all s ∈ (0, s₁] and a.e. v with |v| < a/2; C ≥ 0 and s₁ > 0. ∎
Lean notes: in step 4 rewrite the submodules inside starProjection with a local congruence fact (∀ K₁ K₂ [K₁.HasOrthogonalProjection] [K₂.HasOrthogonalProjection], K₁ = K₂ → K₁.starProjection = K₂.starProjection, by subst; rfl — HasOrthogonalProjection is a Prop); a plain rw fails because the projection instance depends on the submodule. Step 7: lintegral_mono_ae, lintegral_const_mul' (4 ≠ ∞), lintegral_map' (AEMeasurable.mono_measure, continuity of Φ), then gcongr with the measure inequality; measurability of ofReal∘ω by ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.comp (fun_prop) composed with hP.aemeasurable. Decay at radius 2s ≤ s₀ bounds the integral by 4K⁺(2s)^{n+1} = Cs^{n+1}.

The geometric inclusions, projection comparison and measurable pushforward integral comparison are justified. C = 2^(n+3)max(K,0) and s₁ = min(s₀/2,a/8) have the required signs and give the stated bound, including K ≤ 0. Precisely the three declared dependencies are used.
